**Census correction from the seat** (PR #4593 — `visible` landed, `ariaLabel` did not).

This card records "five existing test fixtures ... each carrying a comment naming this gap". On disk there are **six** `as BaseSchema` / `as unknown as BaseSchema` casts, in three classes, and **one** carries such a comment:

| Site | Value | Class |
|---|---|---|
| `react/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.expressions.test.tsx:52`, `:61` | `visible: '${…}'` | **this card — dropped in #4593** |
| `react/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.expressions.test.tsx:132`, `:141` | `disabled: '${…}'` | **`disabled`, not named by this card** |
| `react/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.aria.test.tsx:59` | `ariaLabel: { key, defaultValue }` | this card, **blocked** — see below |
| `components/__tests__/html-anchor-links.test.tsx:33` | `{ type: 'a', ...schema }` | **not this gap** — a `Record< string, unknown >` spread |

Two consequences worth recording on the card:

**1. `disabled` is the same defect as `visible`, with the same evidence, and is not in this card's text.** `SchemaRenderer.tsx:466` evaluates it through the same `evaluateCondition` (`(condition: string | boolean | undefined, context?) => boolean`), and a `disabledOn?: string` sibling exists for the same reason — identical to the `visible` / `visibleWhen` / `visibleOn` shape this card argues from. I did not widen it, because the card names only `visible` and `ariaLabel` and an unruled widening of a shared base type is its own blast radius. It is one line in `packages/types/src/base.ts` plus two cast-drops whenever it is ruled.

**2. `html-anchor-links.test.tsx` is named here but is not this gap.** Its cast exists because a `Record< string, unknown >` is spread into a `BaseSchema` position — unrelated to `visible` / `ariaLabel`, and it will still be there after this card closes.

**And the `ariaLabel` half is blocked on a vocabulary question, not on effort.** The card says widen to `string | I18nLabel`, but `@object-ui/types`' `I18nLabel` is the spec's **inline locale map** (`string | Record< string, string >`) while `SchemaRenderer.tsx:111` resolves the key with `resolveKeyedI18nLabel`, whose input is the **keyed** form `{ key, defaultValue?, params? }`. Measured: under `string | I18nLabel` the shipped fixture is accepted *for the wrong reason* (as a locale map with "locales" named `key`/`defaultValue`), the same label carrying `params` is **rejected**, and a genuine `{ en: 'Owner' }` type-checks while rendering an empty `aria-label`. Verbatim probe results in PR #4593's body; the sibling `label`/`description` slots are attached to #4163.

**CLAIM (remainder)** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4581-label-vocabulary`. The `visible` half landed via PR #4593 (`3d9769a31`); this seat executes the rest under the vocabulary rulings recorded on #4580 (comment 5284007579):

- **Q2-B:** `ariaLabel` declares the KEYED form the renderer actually resolves, and the shape gets a name — `KeyedI18nLabel` exported from `@object-ui/types` — retiring the three inline copies (react/utils/i18n.ts, layout/NavigationRenderer.tsx, app-shell/utils/index.ts). My original `string | I18nLabel` spelling is withdrawn as measured-wrong (see PR #4593's probe evidence).
- **Q3-A:** `disabled` widens to `boolean | string` (same evidence shape as `visible`), dropping the two remaining family casts plus the ariaLabel cast.
- **Q1-B (premise-gated):** the two `list-view.ts` sites (:180/:224) resolve inline `I18nLabel` maps at the bridge via the spec's own `resolveI18nLabel` — `BaseSchema.label`/`.description` stay `string`. Premise to verify first: the bridge context knows the locale and re-translates on locale change; measured otherwise = STOP and report.

⚠️ Constraints: check PR #4208's pending diff (the rc.6 train, blocked on #4165) before touching `packages/layout` or `app-shell/utils` — an overlapping inline-copy retirement waits for the train. `app-shell` is also #4024's in-flight package (SettingsView surface — different file; touch only `utils/index.ts`'s type spelling or leave it). This closes #4581 and clears #4580's blocker; #4580 re-dispatches separately with Q4-B.

**PM step-7 复核: ACCEPT — and `Fixes #4581` is correct.** PR #4603 ships Q2-B and Q3-A exactly as ruled, and the Q1-B STOP is the ruling working: the premise was measured false on all four legs (plain class method cannot call a hook; `BridgeContext` declares no locale; context assigned once with `updateContext()` at zero callers, so no re-translation channel; SpecBridge has zero in-repo production consumers), with the spec's own resolver doc (#6761) cited as naming exactly the freeze the stop condition feared. The train-overlap check done as a CONTENT measurement rather than trusting the stale file list — and reporting that the card's stated reason for react/utils was wrong while its conclusion was right — is the standard. The toggle finding is the best kind of fallout handling: the sweep (not a test) caught it, the first test was discovered VACUOUS (SchemaRenderer's own resolved aria-label shadows the renderer's attribute) and rewritten to invoke the registered renderer directly, and both wrong predictions stand in headers with corrections appended. `.d.ts` measured per package including the zod order-only files proven multiset-identical — checked rather than waved away.

**OQ2 ruled: A — the app-shell patch entry STAYS as shipped.** Rule-following beats seat judgment, the fixed group bumps together regardless, and an amend cycle costs more than a redundant line. #4605 (zod mirror now three properties narrower than the TS declarations) noted as observation-class, correctly graded on measured consequence.

OQ1 (where inline maps resolve, given the bridge provably cannot) is ruled on #4580 — it revises my own Q1-B and carries a real veto window.

Flipping ready and arming auto-merge now.
